mapper.select: select distinct * from mp_auth_role where id in (select "ROLE" from mp_auth_user_role where "USER" = #{userId})

select distinct u.*, wm_concat(distinct ou.org) as orgs, wm_concat(distinct ur."ROLE") as roles from mp_auth_user u left join mp_auth_tenant_user ou on u.id = ou."USER" left join mp_auth_user_role ur on u.id = ur."USER" where u.id in (select "USER" from mp_auth_user_role where "ROLE" = #{roleId}) group by u.id order by u.update_time DESC, u.username ASC

select tabA.rid roleId, tabR.name roleName, tabA.cnt userCnt from (select "ROLE" rid, count("USER") cnt from mp_auth_user_role group by "ROLE") as tabA left join mp_auth_role tabR on tabA.rid = tabR.id order by userCnt DESC
